presentationColumns.name: SKU Week Case ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.SKU Week Case ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden technical identifier for one store-SKU-week AI signal case.

presentationColumns.name: Week Start Date
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Week Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Week represented by the AI signal case. Include this field when you need to see the exact timing of an exception rather than an average across multiple weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Date Key
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Date Key
presentationColumns.description: Hidden date key used to join the AI signal case to the Date dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Store ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Store ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden store key used to join the AI signal case to the Store dimension.

presentationColumns.name: SKU ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.SKU ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden SKU key used to join the AI signal case to the Product dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Style ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Style ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden style key carried from the product hierarchy for the AI signal case.

presentationColumns.name: Collection ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Collection ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden collection key used to join the AI signal case to the Collection dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Cluster ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden cluster key assigned by the product behavior clustering model.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Business Phenomenon
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Business Phenomenon
presentationColumns.description: Business-facing classification of the AI case, such as stockout risk, overstock, return or fit risk, margin pressure, or unexplained anomaly.

presentationColumns.name: Reason Code
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Reason Code
presentationColumns.description: Compact reason label explaining the main driver behind the AI case. Use it to group similar exceptions without reading the longer evidence text.

presentationColumns.name: Recommended Action
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Recommended Action
presentationColumns.description: Short operational action suggested for the individual store-SKU-week AI case.

presentationColumns.name: Business Interpretation
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Business Interpretation
presentationColumns.description: Plain-language interpretation of what the assigned AI signal or cluster means for the business.

presentationColumns.name: Recommended Business Action
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Recommended Business Action
presentationColumns.description: Longer business action guidance associated with the signal or cluster; useful for dashboard detail panes and AI-assisted explanations.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster Label
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Cluster Label
presentationColumns.description: Descriptive label for the behavior cluster assigned to the AI case. Use it to group cases with similar sales, inventory, return, and risk patterns.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster Evidence Summary
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Cluster Evidence Summary
presentationColumns.description: Summary of the behaviors that characterize the assigned cluster, such as demand, sell-through, markdown, returns, stockout risk, or overstock risk.

presentationColumns.name: Stockout Alert Cases
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Stockout Alert Cases
presentationColumns.description: Count of AI cases classified as stockout alerts. This is stricter than a zero-inventory count because it requires the case to meet the stockout risk and demand conditions used by the AI signal layer.

presentationColumns.name: Overstock Alert Cases
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Overstock Alert Cases
presentationColumns.description: Count of AI cases classified as overstock alerts. This is an exception case count, not a raw count of products with inventory on hand.

presentationColumns.name: Affected Stockout Weeks
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Affected Stockout Weeks
presentationColumns.description: Number of distinct weeks with at least one stockout alert case in the selected context. Use this to distinguish a one-week spike from a repeated stockout problem.

presentationColumns.name: Affected Overstock Weeks
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Affected Overstock Weeks
presentationColumns.description: Number of distinct weeks with at least one overstock alert case in the selected context. Use this to distinguish a one-week spike from a repeated overstock problem.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Latest Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Highest stockout risk score in the latest week available for the selected AI cases. Use this when the current state matters more than historical average risk.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Latest Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Highest overstock risk score in the latest week available for the selected AI cases. Use this when the current state matters more than historical average risk.

presentationColumns.name: Peak Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Peak Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Highest stockout risk score reached by the selected AI cases across all included weeks. Use this to rank severity without diluting short but important stockout episodes.

presentationColumns.name: Peak Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Peak Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Highest overstock risk score reached by the selected AI cases across all included weeks. Use this to rank severity without diluting short but important overstock episodes.

presentationColumns.name: Business Exception Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Business Exception Score
presentationColumns.description: Highest business exception score across the selected AI cases. Use this to rank store-SKU-week exceptions by actionability and commercial impact.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Business Exception Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Latest Business Exception Score
presentationColumns.description: Highest business exception score in the latest available week for the selected AI cases. Use this for current exception prioritization.

presentationColumns.name: Anomaly Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Anomaly Count
presentationColumns.description: Count of cases flagged as anomalous.

presentationColumns.name: Anomaly Probability
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Anomaly Probability
presentationColumns.description: Probability that the store-SKU-week case is unusual compared with learned product behavior.

presentationColumns.name: Typical Probability
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Typical Probability
presentationColumns.description: Probability that the store-SKU-week case is typical compared with learned product behavior.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster Probability
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Cluster Probability
presentationColumns.description: Model confidence that the store-SKU-week case belongs to its assigned behavior cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Action Priority
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Action Priority
presentationColumns.description: Priority score used to order recommended business actions.

presentationColumns.name: Units Sold
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Units Sold
presentationColumns.description: Sales quantity observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. It reconciles to core sales quantity when rolled up, but should be used as case evidence beside risk, alert, and recommendation fields rather than as the primary sales KPI.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Full Price Units
presentationColumns.description: Full-price units observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as evidence of demand quality when investigating an AI signal.

presentationColumns.name: Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.description: Net sales observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as impact evidence for an exception; use core Sales KPIs for standard revenue reporting.

presentationColumns.name: Gross Margin Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Gross Margin Amount
presentationColumns.description: Gross margin observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this to judge whether an exception is commercially important.

presentationColumns.name: Returned Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Returned Units
presentationColumns.description: Returned units observed in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as fit, quality, or return-risk evidence within the AI signal workflow.

presentationColumns.name: On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: On-hand inventory in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this as context for the signal; use Inventory KPIs for operational inventory reporting.

presentationColumns.name: Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Available inventory in the store-SKU-week AI case. Use this to understand whether an AI case has sellable stock at the time of the signal.

presentationColumns.name: Markdown Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Markdown Percent
presentationColumns.description: Markdown percent used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Gross Margin Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Gross Margin Percent
presentationColumns.description: Gross margin percent used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Return Rate Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Return Rate Percent
presentationColumns.description: Return rate percent used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Sell Through Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Full Price Sell Through Percent
presentationColumns.description: Full-price sell-through percent used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Unit Share Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Full Price Unit Share Percent
presentationColumns.description: Full-price unit share used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Sell Through Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Sell Through Percent
presentationColumns.description: Sell-through percent used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Stockout Store Rate Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Stockout Store Rate Percent
presentationColumns.description: Store stockout rate used as an AI signal feature.

presentationColumns.name: Average Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Average Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.description: Weeks-of-supply feature used by the AI signal layer.

presentationColumns.name: Demand Index 4W
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Demand Index 4W
presentationColumns.description: Short-term demand index used by the AI signal layer.

presentationColumns.name: Demand Index 13W
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Demand Index 13W
presentationColumns.description: Longer-term demand index used by the AI signal layer.

presentationColumns.name: Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Average store-SKU-week stockout risk across the selected AI cases. Useful for context, but for exception severity prefer Latest Stockout Risk Score, Peak Stockout Risk Score, or Affected Stockout Weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Average store-SKU-week overstock risk across the selected AI cases. Useful for context, but for exception severity prefer Latest Overstock Risk Score, Peak Overstock Risk Score, or Affected Overstock Weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Anomaly Prediction
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Anomaly Prediction
presentationColumns.description: Hidden model output indicating whether the store-SKU-week case is predicted to be anomalous.

presentationColumns.name: Primary Feature ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Primary Feature ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden technical identifier for the model feature that most influenced the AI case. Use Model Evidence or Business Evidence for business-facing explanations.

presentationColumns.name: Primary Feature Value
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Primary Feature Value
presentationColumns.description: Numeric value of the feature that most influenced the AI case; mainly useful for diagnostics alongside the evidence fields.

presentationColumns.name: Model Evidence
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Model Evidence
presentationColumns.description: Model-oriented explanation of the features, scores, or probabilities that influenced the AI case classification.

presentationColumns.name: Business Evidence
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Business Evidence
presentationColumns.description: Business-readable explanation of the sales, inventory, return, margin, or risk signals supporting the AI case.

presentationColumns.name: Margin Alert Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Margin Alert Count
presentationColumns.description: Count of AI signal cases classified as margin alerts.

presentationColumns.name: Return Alert Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Signals.Return Alert Count
presentationColumns.description: Count of AI signal cases classified as return alerts.
